evidence: NESTING ARITHMETIC (static, holds). Frozen task.toml: [agent] timeout_sec = 7200.0; [environment] build_timeout_sec = 600.0; [verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0. Judge timeouts: gates/render/judge.toml:4 timeout = 600; gates/constraints/judge.toml:4 timeout = 600; scored/functional/judge.toml:4 timeout = 9000; scored/polish/judge.toml:4 timeout = 900; scored/visual/judge.toml:4 timeout = 900. test.sh:207 runs each suite as `timeout "$budget_sec" rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1`, test.sh:213 `run_suite gates 1500`, test.sh:224 `run_suite scored 11100`. With max-concurrent-agent 1 the judges run sequentially: gates 600 < 1500 each and 600+600 = 1200 < 1500 (300 s slack); scored 9000, 900, 900 each < 11100 and 9000+900+900 = 10800 < 11100 (300 s slack); 1500 + 11100 = 12600 < 13200 (600 s slack for liveness, copy, prompt substitution, score.py). Internal-sheet form: sum of all judges 600+600+9000+900+900 = 12000 < 13200. Liveness: test.sh:116-122 probes 120 x 0.25 s (plus up to 2 s urlopen per probe) before RewardKit; restart helper waits 120 x 0.25 s (~30 s) inside restart_mcp.py HELPER_TIMEOUT_SEC = 55 (restart_mcp.py:11), so inner < outer. A suite timeout exits 0 with the zero/gate record already written (test.sh:8,60,213-215,224-226), so a timeout never produces an unscored rollout. All values are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff of test.sh: identical; task.toml from [agent] onward: identical; template judge timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900) and to staged-task-contract.md:111 ('gates 1500, scored 11100, verifier 13200'). No timeout change was made, so no authorization record is required. LONG ENOUGH (unmeasured). The template functional dimension carries 2 criteria under 9000 s; this task's functional judge.toml carries 43 [[criterion]] blocks (grep count) in one batched session of a flash judge model, with a 14.5 KB prompt whose script (prompt.md lines 29, 39 and others) demands many independent browser contexts (Rafael, Mei Lin, Tomas, Bill, Ingrid, Aud, anonymous), repeated 'within 15 seconds without reload' waits (hro_live_board, hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up, hro_seen), paged-history loading, draft reloads, API replays (hro_anonymous) and a restart (hro_restart). That is an average of ~209 s per criterion including all navigation. raw-evidence-index.json states explicitly that full configured grading/workload is absent and that the scripted golden run is 'Not a configured judge run, Oracle grade, model score or judge-duration measurement'. Agent 7200 s for a hard full-stack build and build_timeout 600 s for the Dockerfile (node:22-bookworm-slim, apt of 4 packages, global express@5.1.0 + better-sqlite3@12.4.1 prebuilt) look realistic but are likewise unmeasured for this candidate. Per SKILL.md ('Never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass') and REVIEW_POLICY.md ('Workload is measured, not inferred from a timeout number'), the nesting half passes but the adequacy half is Not exercised and is a required missing measurement, hence risk=true. Not a demonstrated Fail: I did not observe a timeout, and canonical budgets must stay unchanged without a measured reason.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that could fail: a correct app whose live updates arrive near the end of the allowed 15 s window and whose conversation history pages slowly; the judge, walking 43 criteria with ~7 independent contexts, multiple 15 s waits, reloads and a restart, exceeds the 9000 s functional judge timeout (or the 11100 s scored suite budget). The functional dimension then returns nothing/zero, the 0.05 functional floor fails, and score.py records reward 0 for a working app, attributing a harness budget overrun to the submission. Plausible broken app that could pass: not applicable to this row (timeouts cannot make a broken app pass; a suite timeout always yields zero).
suggested_fix: Before clearance, run the full configured verifier (claude-code + z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx) on the golden and record per-dimension wall time from rewardkit.log; if functional approaches 9000 s, reduce redundant browser work/criteria with matching public scope, or obtain explicit authorization for a recorded, justified budget change below five hours while keeping the nesting.
